newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: HALLA GROUP, FORD IN ANOTHER AUTO PARTS JV.
newsitem.headline: HALLA GROUP, FORD IN ANOTHER AUTO PARTS JV.

text.p: South Korea's Halla Group said on Tuesday it had signed a memorandum of understanding with U.S. car giant Ford Motor Co to set up a third joint venture between them in the country to make pumps for power steering systems.
The memorandum calls for Halla Group affiliate Mando Machinery Corp and Ford to set up the joint venture in South Korea within this year, a Halla Group statement said.
Mando and Ford already have two auto parts joint ventures in South Korea -- Halla Climate Control Corp in 1985 and Halla Electronics Corp in 1995.
The Halla statement said the two sides also agreed to expand cooperation in the auto parts manufacturing sector.
Products from the planned joint venture would be supplied to Ford and South Korean automakers, it said.
